name: Minecraft: Deluxe Collection for PC
summary:
Experience all the different ways to explore, survive, and build in Minecraft with Minecraft: Deluxe Collection for PC!

Create, explore, survive, repeat. Get Minecraft: Java Edition and Bedrock Edition as a package deal for Windows! With Minecraft: Java & Bedrock Edition for Windows, you can easily switch between games using the unified launcher and cross-play with any current edition of Minecraft.

Browse endless community created content in the Minecraft Marketplace, discover new play styles through different maps, and express yourself with Character Creator items and emotes. Gather your friends or gear up for a solo mission, you’re ready for all the many ways to play Minecraft!
